'''Dune beetles''' were a type of [[Beetle/Legends|beetle]] from [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="SWG" /> They were a subspecies or race of the [[Sand beetle/Legends|sand beetle]].<ref name="SWGTCGPOGG">[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Complete Guide: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Galaxies: The Complete Guide'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:IDontThinkThisIsADroch.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Tatooine "mite" concept art for ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.]]
Dune beetles appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Dune beetles were almost identical to [[Rockmite/Legends|rockmites]], [[rock beetle]]s, [[cave beetle]]s and [[Sand beetle/Legends|sand beetles]], using the same base model with different textures.<ref name="SWG" />
